name: Sorcery
overview: Scripture clearly condemns sorcery, as seen in commands such as 'Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live' (Exodus 22:18) and prohibitions against using enchantments (Leviticus 19:26). The practice of sorcery is depicted as deceptive and ineffective before God's power, exemplified by the Egyptian magicians who imitated but ultimately could not replicate God's miracles (Exodus 7:11, 7:22, 8:7, 8:18). These passages emphasize that sorcery is forbidden and powerless compared to the sovereign authority of the Lord.
